item.title: IDF opens fire at terrorists planning to throw rocks at Israeli vehicles in Samaria, hits confirmed
item.description:
IDF troops operating overnight on the outskirts of the village of Burqa in Samaria spotted several terrorists preparing to throw rocks at a highway used by Israeli vehicles.
According to the IDF Spokesperson's Unit, the operation was conducted in an area where several rock-throwing attacks against Israeli vehicles have recently occurred. The troops opened fire at the terrorists to eliminate the threat, and hits were confirmed.

item.title: Farley Weiss: "The Jewish People Are Too Much on the Defensive"
item.description: During a solidarity mission to Israel, Farley Weiss warned of growing anti-Israel sentiment in American politics but stressed that Israel still has powerful friends in Washington. "We have to be on the offensive," he said.

item.description: As Netanyahu warns against a government dependent on Arab parties, his close associate Natan Eshel has been working behind the scenes to communicate with Mansour Abbas.

item.title: Mysterious Russian plane that landed in Israel was carrying Russian officials
item.description: A source familiar with the details told Kan News that senior Russian officials were aboard the Russian aircraft that landed at Ben Gurion Airport yesterday. According to the report, the landing may have been a stopover en route to a Russia-Ukraine peace summit scheduled to be hosted by the United States in Abu Dhabi tomorrow.

item.title: 'Never Again' faces historic test, German Chancellor warns
item.description: Marking Kristallnacht's 88th anniversary, Chancellor Friedrich Merz warns of widespread antisemitism, pledges support for Israel, and urges action.

item.title: 3,039 dunams: Major development project advances in Gush Etzion
item.description: IDF Central Command chief Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth has signed an order establishing the jurisdictional boundaries of a new industrial zone near the Tarkumiya Crossing, which is expected to strengthen Gush Etzion's economy.

item.title: "Historic achievement": Another community officially recognized in northern Samaria
item.description: The Interior Ministry has granted an official locality code to the community of Noa in northern Samaria, completing its regularization process and granting it formal recognition.

item.title: Trump's Board of Peace criticizes Israel, Hamas following Gaza floods
item.description: The Board of Peace calls on Israel to accelerate entry of winter supplies after severe flooding in Gaza, while also demanding that Hamas disarm.

item.title: PA arrests suspects in sale of Jericho homes to Jews
item.description:
A spokesman for the Palestinian Authority security forces confirmed that suspects were arrested for selling houses to Jews near Jericho.
According to the Saudi newspaper "Asharq Al-Awsat", the detainees are intermediaries who were involved in transferring the houses to Jews.

item.title: Board of Peace criticizes both Israel and Hamas
item.description: Following the flooding in Gaza, the Board of Peace called on Israel to accelerate the entry of humanitarian supplies into the Strip, and on Hamas to disarm and transfer power. The council warned that those who fail to meet their commitments will face consequences.

item.title: Voters in 8 Illinois communities back repeal of anti-BDS law
item.description: Voters in eight Illinois communities back nonbinding measures opposing the state's anti-BDS law, despite objections from local Jewish organizations.

item.title: IDF: Over 91,000 tents, 8,200 trucks of winter supplies enter Gaza
item.description: IDF and COGAT advance winter preparations in Gaza, facilitating the entry of shelter equipment, medical supplies, and sanitation infrastructure while working to prevent Hamas from exploiting humanitarian aid.

item.title: France accuses Iran of cyberattack on supermarket refrigerators
item.description: France has accused Iran of responsibility for the cyberattack on supermarket refrigerators and warned that Iran "will bear the consequences."

item.title: Defense Ministry: Flydubai passengers to be recognized as victims of terrorism
item.description: Following official confirmation from investigative authorities, the Defense Ministry has recognized the attempted terrorist attack on a flight to Israel as an act of terrorism and referred the decision to the National Insurance Institute.

item.title: Blinken and Pompeo agree: End of US military aid won't hurt Israel ties
item.description: Former US Secretaries of State Blinken and Pompeo say ending military aid would not weaken US-Israel ties, but disagree sharply over Iran and Gaza.
